title: Enforcement Decree of the Traffic, Energy and Environment Tax Act
full_text:
Article 25 (Reporting on founding or closure of business) (1) A person who intends to file a report under the former part of Article 18(1) of the Act or paragraph (3) of the same Article, shall submit a report prescribed by Decree of the Ministry of Finance and Economy to the head of the tax office having jurisdiction over the manufacturing place or the head of the tax office having jurisdiction over the head office or principal office by no later than five days prior to the commencement of the business. <Amended on Dec. 23, 1994; Dec. 31, 1999; Feb. 29, 2008; Dec. 30, 2010; Dec. 30, 2025>
  (2) In the case of a business requiring permission, authorization, registration, etc. (hereafter in this paragraph referred to as "authorization or permission") pursuant to statutes or regulations, a copy of a certificate on such authorization or permission (before the grant of authorization or permission, a copy of an application for such authorization or permission or a business plan) shall be submitted along with a report under paragraph (1); provided, a person registered pursuant to Article 8 of the Value Added Tax Act need not submit such certificate. <Amended on Dec. 31, 1999; Jul. 8, 2005; Jun. 28, 2013>
  (3) Where a manufacturer of taxable articles intends to suspend its business for at least one month pursuant to the latter part of Article 18(1) of the Act, he or she shall submit a report prescribed by Decree of the Ministry of Finance and Economy to the head of the competent tax office before such suspension. <Amended on Dec. 23, 1994; Dec. 31, 1999; Feb. 29, 2008; Dec. 30, 2025>
  (4) Where a person who has filed a report under paragraphs (1) through (3) amends a reported matter or closes the relevant business, he or she shall, without delay, submit a report prescribed by Decree of the Ministry of Finance and Economy to the head of the tax office having jurisdiction over the manufacturing place or the head of the tax office having jurisdiction over the head office or principal office; provided, where a manufacturer of taxable articles submits a report under Article 12, specifying the date of cessation of business and reason for the cessation thereof, he or she shall be deemed to have submitted a report of cessation of business. <Amended on Dec. 23, 1994; Dec. 31, 1999; Feb. 29, 2008; Dec. 30, 2010; Dec. 30, 2025>
  (5) Where an entrepreneur who has filed a report on business unit pursuant to Article 18(3) or (4) of the Act intends to report his or her tax base under Article 7 of the Act for each manufacturing place, he or she shall submit a report of conversion to filing on unit of manufacturing place prescribed by Decree of the Ministry of Finance and Economy to the head of the tax office having jurisdiction over the head office or principal office by no later than 20 days prior to the commencement of the month in which he or she intends to be treated as a taxable entrepreneur on unit of manufacturing place. <Added on Feb. 21, 2014; Dec. 30, 2025>
  (6) The head of a tax office in receipt of a report of conversion to filing on manufacturing place pursuant to paragraph (5) shall notify, without delay, the result of the processing thereof to the relevant entrepreneur and the heads of tax offices having jurisdiction over other manufacturing places. <Added on Feb. 21, 2014>
